row.notes: In Game_GarageCrewModule_SpawnGarageCrew: test rdi,rdi / je 0x14038baff right after the hoisted byte read of [rdi+0xe0]; a null scene handle takes the je to the null path (ebx = eax = 0, stores at [rbp+0x2f0..0x310]). Core lands here with esi = 0 when rdi is null. Owner review re-career-teams 2026-11-02: own disasm: test rdi,rdi / je 0x14038baff; baff zeroes ebx and eax and joins 0x14038bb0a, which stores rax to [rbp+0x2f0] and sil to [rbp+0x308] at bb19, so the hook must set esi=0 (false flag) before landing. Agrees with V8626.

verify.notes: V8626 test rdi,rdi / je baff at ba27/ba2a; baff zeroes ebx,eax and falls to bb0a without writing esi. Note esi is NOT dead: bb19 stores sil to [rbp+0x308], so esi=0 is required (false flag), and the non-null path loads real byte there; hook setting esi=0 is correct.
